subject.title: Plugin register() promises silently ignored — async registration not awaited

question: Should nix-openclaw preserve the pinned upstream synchronous plugin-registration contract, or sponsor an upstream proposal for awaitable `register()` hooks?
rationale: Awaiting `register()` promises changes the plugin lifecycle contract, while current evidence has not established that nix-openclaw packages incorrect or mixed artifacts.

options.title: Verify package provenance first
options.body: Request exact gateway and plugin provenance plus a current verbose trace, then make a narrow package repair only if they prove an artifact mismatch.

options.title: Sponsor upstream lifecycle support
options.body: Seek upstream agreement on awaitable registration semantics, compatibility behavior, and validation before changing the packaged runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Verify package provenance first
recommendation.body: Request exact gateway and plugin provenance plus a current verbose trace, then make a narrow package repair only if they prove an artifact mismatch.
